title: Fix stale VTCLivestream destroy quote in livestream test
description:
Found in batch 38 (JMAP-z4z0.8): three quotes it did not check. Checked 2026-11-01 against jmap-chat-spec 77c3474:
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:1880 (deletedForAll / edit rule): CORRECT. chat L1266 'Servers MUST reject deletedForAll: true for messages where senderId is not the accountId with a forbidden SetError' and L1228 'The server MUST reject an edit of any other message with a forbidden SetError'. No change.
- crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:628: CORRECT, verbatim at federation L1313 'both servers MUST adopt min(X, Y) (lexicographically smaller)'. No change.
- crate-jmap-vtc-server/tests/livestream.rs:108: STALE. Quotes 'L1207 The server MUST return forbidden when the caller is not a moderator.' That sentence was in the VTCLivestream destroy section at 3227c0f L1207 and is gone at 77c3474. The governing text is now vtc L1356 'Only participants with role: "moderator" ... MAY create, update, or destroy VTCLivestream objects. Non-moderators SHOULD receive forbidden.', already quoted a few lines up at livestream.rs:100. Fix: drop the L1207 quote and let the destroy assertion rely on the L1356 quote above (enforced by this crate's choice). Comment-only; no assertion change.
close_reason: Batch 40: e9e06a9e; stale 'MUST return forbidden when the caller is not a moderator' quote removed from livestream.rs and media.rs destroy_media doc; local CI green 6741
